def contact_sheets(pngs, folder, per_sheet=9):
    """Thumbnails of the checked figures, nine to a sheet with their paths, in <folder>/_contact_sheets/: a quick way
    to look at every figure. A thumbnail shows gross defects only; open the full PNG where one looks wrong and for the
    figures a conclusion rests on."""
    import matplotlib
    matplotlib.use('Agg')
    import matplotlib.image as mpimg
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    out = Path(folder) / SHEET_DIR
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for old in out.glob('sheet_*.png'):
        old.unlink()
    written = []
    for s in range(0, len(pngs), per_sheet):
        batch = pngs[s:s + per_sheet]
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 3, figsize=(15, 15))
        for ax, png in zip(axes.flat, batch):
            try:
                ax.imshow(mpimg.imread(png))
            except Exception as e:  # an unreadable file is itself worth seeing
                ax.text(.5, .5, f'unreadable: {e}', ha='center', va='center', wrap=True)
            ax.set_title(str(png)[-70:], fontsize=8)
        for ax in axes.flat:
            ax.axis('off')
        path = out / f'sheet_{s // per_sheet + 1:02d}.png'
        fig.savefig(path, dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
        plt.close(fig)
        written.append(str(path))
    return written


def check(folders, report_path=None, sheets=True):
    """PNG files without a matching figure record, records whose PNG changed, recorded layout warnings, and,
    with a report, whether the report takes up what the render notes asked for."""
    report = {'recorded': [], 'not_recorded': [], 'changed_after_record': [], 'layout_warnings': [],
              'checks_not_declared': [], 'missing_folders': [], 'report_missing': [], 'report_reminders': []}
    summaries, inspected = [], set()

    def inspect(png):
        if png.resolve() in inspected:  # overlapping folders (or a report link) name the same figure once
            return
        inspected.add(png.resolve())
        records_path = png.parent / 'figure-records.json'
        records = json.loads(records_path.read_text()) if records_path.exists() else []
        entry = next((r for r in records if r.get('file') == png.name), None)
        if entry is None:
            report['not_recorded'].append(str(png))
            return
        if entry.get('png_sha256') and entry['png_sha256'] != figure_style._sha256(png):
            report['changed_after_record'].append(str(png))
            return
        report['recorded'].append(str(png))
        checks = entry.get('checks', {})
        if checks.get('map_crs') == 'not declared' and checks.get('pair_counts') == 'not declared':
            report['checks_not_declared'].append(str(png))
        for w in checks.get('layout_warnings', []):
            report['layout_warnings'].append(f'{png}: {w}')

    for folder in folders:
        folder = Path(folder)
        if not folder.is_dir():
            report['missing_folders'].append(str(folder))
            continue
        summaries += [json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in folder.rglob('stage-evidence-summary.json')
                      if p.resolve() not in inspected and not inspected.add(p.resolve())]
        for png in sorted(folder.rglob('*.png')):
            if SHEET_DIR not in png.parts:  # the contact sheets check writes are not figures of the analysis
                inspect(png)
    if report_path is not None:
        import re
        text = Path(report_path).read_text(errors='replace') if Path(report_path).exists() else ''
        if not text:
            report['report_missing'].append(f'report not found or empty: {report_path}')
        # Figures the report shows or names are checked too, wherever they were saved; figures beside the input table are inputs.
        from urllib.parse import unquote
        seen = {Path(p).resolve() for k in ('recorded', 'not_recorded', 'changed_after_record') for p in report[k]}
        tables = [Path(s['input_table']) for s in summaries if s.get('input_table') and Path(s['input_table']).exists()]
        base = Path(report_path).resolve().parent

        def delivered_with_input(path):  # beside the input table and not newer than it: an input figure
            return any(path.parent == tb.parent and path.stat().st_mtime <= tb.stat().st_mtime + 60 for tb in tables)
        link = re.compile(r'\]\(\s*<?([^)<>]+?\.png)>?(?:\s+"[^"]*")?\s*\)|<img[^>]+src="([^"]+?\.png)"', re.I)
        linked = [unquote(md or html) for md, html in link.findall(text)]  # Markdown or HTML links, spaces and %20 allowed
        named = re.findall(r'[\w./-]*\w\.png\b', link.sub(' ', text), re.I)  # file names in the text outside links
        for ref, explicit in [(r, True) for r in dict.fromkeys(linked)] + [(r, False) for r in dict.fromkeys(named)]:
            found = next((c.resolve() for c in (base / ref, Path.cwd() / ref) if c.is_file()), None)
            if found is None:
                if explicit:
                    report['report_missing'].append(f'the report links a figure that does not exist: {ref}')
                elif not any(p.name.lower() == Path(ref).name.lower() for p in seen | inspected):
                    report['report_reminders'].append(f'the report names a figure that was not found: {ref}')
                continue
            if found in seen or found in inspected or delivered_with_input(found) or SHEET_DIR in found.parts:
                continue
            seen.add(found)
            inspect(found)
        for summary in summaries:
            for note in summary.get('notes', []):
                for col in note.get('columns', []) if note.get('interpret') else []:
                    if not re.search(rf'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_]){re.escape(col["column"])}(?![A-Za-z0-9_])', text):
                        report['report_reminders'].append(f"not named in the report: {col['column']} ({note.get('kind', 'value check')})")
                if note.get('kind') == 'map-unit distances' and not re.search(
                        r'mercator|메르카토르|map[- ]units?|지도 단위|reproject|재투영', text, re.I):
                    report['report_reminders'].append('Mercator coordinates: distances and areas in map units (reprojected, or the factor stated)')
                if note.get('kind') == 'no expectations':
                    report['report_reminders'].append('no expected directions declared: still link the predictors whose '
                                                      'identity is known (from the name or data description, even without '
                                                      'units) and the candidates to the domain model (e.g. the deposit model '
                                                      'of the commodity the request or data description names), as labelled '
                                                      'hypotheses where the data cannot confirm them; for a predictor whose '
                                                      'identity cannot be established, withhold its interpretation and say '
                                                      'what definition would allow it')
                if note.get('stage') == 'M2' and note.get('still_rising'):
                    report['report_reminders'].append('M2 semivariance still rising at the last lag: how the block size was '
                                                      'chosen without a range (longer lags, trend, or another basis)')
                if note.get('stage') == 'M4' and note.get('note', '').startswith('one model only'):
                    report['report_reminders'].append('one model only: baseline comparison or the reason for none')
            for n in summary.get('not_drawn', []):
                report['report_reminders'].append(f"not drawn: {n['stage']} ({n['reason'][:80]}) - drawn elsewhere, or stated in the report")
        values = []
        for path in dict.fromkeys(r for s in summaries for r in s.get('decision_records', [])):
            try:
                rec = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
            except (OSError, ValueError):
                continue
            if 'block' in rec and 'assignment' in rec:
                b, a = rec['block'], rec['assignment']
                inner = sorted({len(x.get('folds', [])) for x in a.get('inner', [])})
                values.append(f"{len(a['outer']['folds'])} outer / {'-'.join(map(str, inner))} inner folds, block "
                              f"{b['size'][0]:g} {b.get('unit', '')} ({b['basis']})")
            elif 'config' in rec and 'tiers' in rec['config']:
                g = rec['config']
                text_ = (f"tiers {g['tiers']} ({g['zone_mode']}), alpha {g['alpha']} (screen {g.get('screen_rule', 'pool')}), "
                         f"rel IQR cut {g['rel_iqr_cut']}" + (f", far-target gap {g['new_gap']} grid steps" if 'new_gap' in g else ''))
                d = rec.get('deployment', {}).get(g.get('primary'), {})
                if d.get('cells_ranked_in_tiers') and d.get('tier_cells_moved_by_uncertainty') == 0:
                    text_ += (f" (the rel IQR cut moves none of the {d['cells_ranked_in_tiers']} tier cells of the map; "
                              f"tier rel IQR p10/p50/p90 {[round(v, 3) for v in d.get('tier_rel_iqr_p10_p50_p90') or []]})")
                if g.get('rezoned_from'):
                    text_ += (f"; revised from {g['previous_decision_values']} because: {g['rezone_reason']} (if the "
                              'revision followed held-out capture or coverage, those held-out results are development '
                              'evidence: say so)')
                values.append(text_)
        if values:
            report['report_reminders'].append('decision values: give the reason for each from the purpose, budget or data '
                                              '(not a default or another study; a definition of the value is not a reason: '
                                              'say what it was weighed against, e.g. the budget, the cost of missing a '
                                              'positive, the rel IQR spread): ' + ' | '.join(values))
        evidence = False
        for folder in folders:
            for kind in CANDIDATE_KINDS.values():
                for path in Path(folder).rglob(f"{kind['m7']}_evidence.csv"):
                    ids = pd.read_csv(path, dtype=str)['candidate']
                    evidence = evidence or len(ids) > 0
                    # Hangul particles may follow an id ("후보 A는"); short or numeric ids need a candidate word before them
                    named = lambda i: re.search(rf'(?<![A-Za-z0-9_]){re.escape(i)}(?![A-Za-z0-9_])' if len(i) >= 3 and not i.isdigit()
                                                else rf'(?:candidate|후보|target|patch)\s*[#:]?\s*{re.escape(i)}(?![A-Za-z0-9_])', text, re.I)
                    if not any(named(i) for i in ids):
                        report['report_reminders'].append(f"{kind['stage']} evidence: no {kind['word']} from {path.name} is named")
        if evidence and not re.search(r'가설|hypothe[st]', text, re.I):  # a word match, not a check of the interpretation
            report['report_reminders'].append('candidate interpretation: for the leading candidates give the observed '
                                              'values and status, and link them to the domain model through the '
                                              'predictors whose identity is known (what it expects, what the candidate '
                                              'shows, what data would test it), marked as hypotheses where the data cannot '
                                              'confirm them')
    report['report_reminders'] = list(dict.fromkeys(report['report_reminders']))
    checked = sorted({p for k in ('recorded', 'not_recorded', 'changed_after_record') for p in report[k]})
    report['contact_sheets'] = contact_sheets(checked, folders[0]) if sheets and checked and Path(folders[0]).is_dir() else []
    return report


def template(table, metadata=None):
    """A first spec from the input table: cells and predictors guessed, CRS from metadata if found.

    Every guess must be checked: the id/x/y/label columns, the unit and spacing, the CRS, and which
    columns are predictors (label-derived counts, identifiers and survey proxies are listed apart)."""
    import re
    frame = pd.read_csv(table, nrows=200_000)
    cols = list(frame.columns)
    pick = lambda pattern: next((c for c in cols if re.fullmatch(pattern, c, re.I)), None)
    idc = pick(r'cell_?id|id|cell') or cols[0]
    x = pick(r'x|easting|east|x_m|lon|longitude')
    y = pick(r'y|northing|north|y_m|lat|latitude')
    binary = lambda c: pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(frame[c]) and set(frame[c].dropna().unique()) <= {0, 1}
    # a 0/1 column named like a label; counts such as n_positive are not labels
    label = next((c for c in cols if re.search(r'label|target|positive|class|^lab', c, re.I) and binary(c)), None)
    if label is None:  # fall back to the first 0/1 column that is not an id or coordinate
        label = next((c for c in cols if c not in (idc, x, y) and binary(c)), None)
    xs = np.unique(frame[x].to_numpy(float)) if x else np.array([])
    ys = np.unique(frame[y].to_numpy(float)) if y else np.array([])
    def step(u):  # the most common gap: off-grid edge cells (e.g. partial blocks) add smaller ones
        if len(u) < 2:
            return None
        gaps, counts = np.unique(np.round(np.diff(u), 6), return_counts=True)
        return float(gaps[np.argmax(counts)])
    unit = 'degree' if x and np.nanmax(np.abs(xs)) <= 360 else 'm'
    crs, crs_note = 'EPSG:????', 'not found in the metadata: name it from the data description'
    if metadata:
        text = Path(metadata).read_text(errors='replace').replace('\\"', '"')  # WKT inside a JSON string
        found = re.search(r'EPSG\s*:?\s*(\d{4,6})', text, re.I)
        wkt = re.search(r'(PROJCS|PROJCRS|GEOGCS|GEOGCRS)\s*\[\s*"([^"]+)"', text)
        if found:
            crs, crs_note = f'EPSG:{found.group(1)}', 'EPSG code from the metadata'
        elif wkt:  # a WKT definition without an EPSG code: its name, marked as such
            crs = f'{wkt.group(2)} (metadata WKT, no EPSG code)'
            crs_note = 'named from a WKT definition in the metadata; say in the report that no EPSG code was given'
    skip = {idc, x, y, label} | {c for c in cols if re.fullmatch(r'row|col|column|in_aoi', c, re.I)}
    suspect = [c for c in cols if c not in skip and re.search(r'deposit|occurrence|event|inventory|presence|count|^n_|names?$|label|mine', c, re.I)]
    numeric = [c for c in cols if c not in skip and c not in suspect and pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(frame[c])]
    coded = [c for c in numeric if 2 < frame[c].nunique() <= 12 and np.allclose(frame[c].dropna() % 1, 0)]
    text = [c for c in cols if c not in skip and c not in suspect and not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(frame[c])
            and 1 < frame[c].nunique() <= 30]
    spec = {
        'out': 'figures',
        'cells': {'table': str(table), 'id': idc, 'x': x, 'y': y, 'unit': unit, 'crs': crs,
                  'spacing': [step(xs), step(ys)], 'label': label, 'positive': 1, 'unlabeled': 0,
                  'class_names': ['Recorded positive', 'Unlabeled (not a confirmed negative)'], 'class_short': ['P', 'U']},
        'predictors': [{'column': c, 'title': c, 'unit': '', 'map': i < 3} for i, c in enumerate(numeric)]
                      + [{'column': c, 'title': c, 'type': 'categorical', 'map': False} for c in text],
        'dependence': {'edges': variogram.lag_edges(step(xs), min(np.ptp(xs), np.ptp(ys)))} if unit != 'degree' and step(xs) and len(ys) > 1 else None,
        '_check_before_render': [f'cells: id, x, y, label, unit, spacing and CRS (CRS {crs_note})'
                                 + ('' if x and y else '; coordinate columns not recognised: set cells.x, cells.y and the '
                                    'spacing, and move them out of the predictors'), 'predictors: units, titles, display '
                                 'scales, which to map; remove any that are not predictors; role, and expect (high/low) '
                                 'with basis where the domain model (e.g. deposit model) predicts a direction',
                                 f'columns kept out as possible label-derived or proxy columns: {suspect}',
                                 f'numeric columns with few whole-number values, possibly category codes (set "type": '
                                 f'"categorical" if so): {coded}',
                                 'add assignment, heldout, scores, stability, zones, candidates as their tables are saved'],
    }
    if spec['dependence'] is None:
        spec.pop('dependence')
    return spec


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split('\n\n')[0])
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command', required=True)
    r = sub.add_parser('render')
    r.add_argument('spec')
    k = sub.add_parser('check')
    k.add_argument('folders', nargs='+')
    k.add_argument('--report', help='the report; checks that it takes up the render notes')
    k.add_argument('--no-sheets', action='store_true', help='do not write contact sheets of the checked figures')
    t = sub.add_parser('template')
    t.add_argument('table')
    t.add_argument('--metadata')
    a = parser.parse_args(argv)
    if a.command == 'template':
        print(json.dumps(template(a.table, a.metadata), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
        return 0
    if a.command == 'render':
        summary = Renderer(json.loads(Path(a.spec).read_text())).run()
        for f in summary['figures']:
            print('figure', f['file'], '-', f['question'])
        for n in summary['not_drawn']:
            print('not drawn', n['stage'], '-', n['reason'])
        for n in summary['notes']:
            print('note', json.dumps(n, ensure_ascii=False, default=str))
        print(summary['reminder'])
        return 0
    report = check(a.folders, a.report, sheets=not a.no_sheets)
    for p in report['missing_folders']:
        print('folder not found:', p)
    for p in report['not_recorded']:
        print('no record (drawn outside the checked path; re-save with figure_style.save_figure or report what you checked by eye):', p)
    for p in report['changed_after_record']:
        print('changed after its record (re-save through save_figure):', p)
    for w in report['layout_warnings']:
        print('layout warning:', w)
    for m in report['report_missing']:
        print('report problem:', m)
    for m in report['report_reminders']:
        print('report reminder:', m)
    if report['report_reminders']:
        print('(reminders are word matches: take up what applies; naming a column is not an interpretation)')
    if report['checks_not_declared']:
        print(f"{len(report['checks_not_declared'])} recorded figures declared no map or dependence check (fine for non-map plots)")
    for sheet in report['contact_sheets']:
        print('contact sheet:', sheet)
    print(f"{len(report['recorded'])} recorded, {len(report['not_recorded'])} without record. Look at every figure (the "
          "contact sheets show them all; open the full PNG where one looks wrong and for those a conclusion rests on), "
          "and write in the report only the checks you made.")
    bad = (report['missing_folders'] or report['not_recorded'] or report['changed_after_record'] or report['layout_warnings']
           or report['report_missing'])
    return 1 if bad else 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    sys.exit(main())
